Shared IMPL-ENABLER (architect's decomposition, NOT a separate Tron-observable): the RepoRegistry becomes a DYNAMIC, mutable, persisted registry (add/register/clone/switch at runtime) - superseding the R30.40 static ROOTS allowlist. Architect derives the impl-units (dynamic-registry / add-local / add-clone / manage-switch); I mint/re-point methods+impls on confirm.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The MANAGE panel shows, for the current repo: local server path, current branch, and the list of available worktrees.
Each worktree is SWITCHABLE: selecting one repoints the active checkout/worktree so diff/header/save use it (consistent with R30.40 HOME/oosh symlink-follow).
After a switch, the center header + diff reflect the newly-selected worktree's branch (dynamic, per R30.40).
[PENDING Tron ratify] Worktree switching only repoints among the repo OWN ratified worktrees (bounded) - not an arbitrary path; consistent with R30.40 HOME/oosh symlink-follow.
[PENDING Tron ratify] Managing/switching is gated by the ratified authorization model.
GATE (DET-3x + Tron visual): open manage -> shows path+branch+worktrees; switch a worktree -> header/diff track it; client-facing -> version-bump.
